assessment: The manuscript is an important study which aims to demonstrate the conserved and crucial role of IgM in both systemic and mucosal antiviral immunity in teleost, challenging the established differential roles of IgT and IgM. The strength of the evidence is solid and supported by a combination of in vivo studies, viral infection models, and complementary in vitro assays. In the current version, authors validate the MoAb against IgM
